title: Page 152
transc:
Wash'n May 26 1864
General Sheldon Ft. Monroe
you will see from Jacobs order today
to Knox what course the latters oyster
will take and about what may be
expected in way of weather facilities in
direction of white house latter will probably
be made base of supplies from there
it may be necessary to extend up
the peninsula on tumble side pay monkey
perhaps to Johnson snake in anticipation of
the wants & ship you today by 
steamer detroit leg spoons material wire insulation
and spikes which you will prepare to
receive and store until further orders with
this shipment how much material will you
have at your command and about how
much will your require do you know
whether any poles and wire still remain
up between Hindoo and White house if
it has all been quinced I want
your views in to best route to
take in building anew whether over old
route or to cross at Wilson Vernon
with cable thence along galway and York
Windpipe welch to any vernon desired turn
matter over in your mind and let
